H2A-Lite (Hydrogen Analysis Lite Production model), version 1.5, revision May 2026 (Excel macro workbook h2a-lite.xlsm). Alliance for Energy Innovation, LLC for the U.S. Department of Energy, Golden, CO. Contact h2fast@nrel.gov. Embedded supplemental references: Acevedo et al. 2023 (alkaline electrolysis, https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/2203367); Hubert et al. 2024 (PEM electrolysis); Prosser et al. 2023 (solid oxide electrolysis); Lewis et al. 2022, NETL, Comparison of Commercial, State-of-the-Art, Fossil-Based Hydrogen Production Technologies (SMR, SMR+CCS, ATR+CCS); Penev et al. 2024 (financing).

Read with openpyxl data_only=True (cached values, macros not run) from h2a-lite.xlsm (v1.5; Description!B16-B17 revision history, latest May 2026; copyright 2025). Locator = workbook sheet name + cell (with row label); no page numbers. STRUCTURE TRAP: the H2ALite and Interface sheets only hold cached results for the pathway selected when the file was saved (Central SMR no CCS, startup 2024, 2023$); results for other pathways need a recalculation in Excel. Per-pathway values were therefore read from the case input sheets (ALK/PEM Electrolyzer Data, SAIncALK, SOEC Electrolysis Info, SMR Case 1, SMR+CCS Case 2, ATR+CCS Case 3, Pyrolysis Inputs) and the SERACosts/SERAInputs lookup tables. LOADED (11 examples): grid ALK 1,035 MW and grid PEM 400 MW (2022$; total installed and equipment capex, component split stack/power electronics/BOP/H2 conditioning, kWh/kg, utilization, life, fixed O&M % of capex, non-energy variable O&M); four Acevedo et al. 2023 ALK cases reprinted on SAIncALK (current/future x 50/500 t/d, 2020$; future dated 2030 by H2A-Lite); SOEC 1 GW DC (2020$, Prosser et al. 2023 basis; electricity and natural-gas heat, 4-yr stack life); SMR, SMR+CCS and ATR+CCS on NETL 2022 Cases 1-3 as normalised for H2A-Lite (2018$ capex, fixed and variable O&M, HHV natural gas, electricity, water, steam co-product, CO2 captured, plant capture share); plasma methane pyrolysis (PRELIMINARY, do-not-cite flag on the sheet). SMR also carries the cached LCOH 1.2237 2023$/kg and HHV efficiency. NOT LOADED: NETL 2022 exhibits reprinted on SMR/SMR+CCS/ATR+CCS/NETL cases cross cutting sheets (stream tables, performance and cost exhibits) - already extracted as netl_2022_002; coal gasification w/CCS (NETL Case 5 description; SERA lookup has no row at the 660,000 kg/d default size, usage values put in other-values); biomass gasification (SERA lookup values identical to H2A v3.2018, already nrel_2018_003); wind/solar/hybrid PEM variants (same electrolyzer, different power supply; ATB2024 wind/solar out of scope); delivery, storage, pipeline and station technologies; financial model sheets. Electrolyzer learning: all component learning rates are 0 in this version, so capex and kWh/kg are constant 2020-2050; only annualized replacement % varies by year (other-values), hence no separate future-year electrolyzer processes. BASES: natural gas MMBtu per kg H2 on HHV (Oct 2024 revision note; SOEC and pyrolysis cells say HHV). Electricity per kg H2 is system AC. Capex labelled "Total installed capital cost" on H2ALite!B11 recorded as installed; pyrolysis 625 MM$ is total overnight (E21). Dollar years: electrolyzer data sheets 2022$ (D3); SOEC rows labelled 2020$ though C4 says 2021; NETL-based sheets 2018$; SAIncALK 2020$; SERA-table variable O&M taken as 2020$ from the table header (inferred); pyrolysis 2018$ inferred from its CEPCI block and Dec-2018 cost table (sheet itself asks "2023?"). ERRORS IN CACHED VALUES: #N/A in SMR+CCS Case 2 and ATR+CCS Case 3 E12:E14 (CO2 T&S variable cost) and throughout CO2 T&S sheet (lookup not resolved for the saved pathway); #REF! in SERACosts (188 cells, unused index rows) and #VALUE!/#DIV/0! in CapEx, G0-G9, Storage configs, SERA_IO_VALS K74:K80; none feeds a loaded value. ALK Electrolyzer Data SERA export rows are labelled "Central Grid Electrolysis (PEM)" (template carry-over); SERAInputs carries PEM electrolyzer inputs (55.5 kWh/kg) because PEM is the exported electrolyzer. SUPERSEDES in nrel_2018_003 (H2A v3.2018): current/future central natural gas without CCS (SMR), current/future central natural gas with CCS, current/future central PEM electrolysis, current/future central solid oxide electrolysis. NOT superseded: central biomass gasification (reused unchanged), central coal with CCS (no default-size cost here), all distributed/forecourt cases (natural gas SMR, ethanol SR, PEM).
